RebelErrorTracking.DocApi: The reports are available in the reporting API of Matomo, for users with view access to the website:
RebelErrorTracking.DocCapture: JavaScript errors with their file, line, column and stack trace. Promises that are rejected without being handled. Images, scripts and stylesheets that fail to load. Violations of the Content Security Policy of the website. A website can also turn on browser warnings: features it uses that the browser has deprecated, and things the browser stopped it from doing.
RebelErrorTracking.DocDelay: The reports are built when Matomo processes its reports, so a new error shows up the next time the reports of the day are processed. The occurrences under an error are read directly from the stored errors: they do not follow a segment, and they are gone when the errors are deleted, while the numbers stay.
RebelErrorTracking.DocEarly: The tracker is usually loaded late, and an error that is thrown before it is not seen. To catch those too, put this first in the head of the website. The tracker sends what the snippet collected as soon as it is loaded.
RebelErrorTracking.DocEarlyTitle: Errors before the tracker is loaded
RebelErrorTracking.DocIntro: Rebel Error Tracking stores the errors that happen in the browsers of your visitors and reports them for each website: what went wrong, how often, in which browsers and on which pages.
RebelErrorTracking.DocOtherDomains: For a script from another domain, a browser reports only "Script error." without a file or a stack trace. To get the real error, load the script with the crossorigin attribute and serve it with a header that allows your website:
RebelErrorTracking.DocOtherDomainsTitle: Errors from scripts on other domains
RebelErrorTracking.DocReports: Errors in the reporting menu shows the chosen website and period. "Errors over time" is a graph of the errors, the new errors, the visits with an error, or the error rate, which is the share of all visits that had an error. "Errors in numbers" gives the same four for the period. "Errors" lists each error with how often it happened, in how many visits, the browsers it happened most in, and when it was first and last seen; an error that was first seen in the period is marked as new. Click an error to see its latest occurrences with the page, the browser, the place in the code and the stack trace. The time of an occurrence opens that visit in the visit log. "Errors by browser" and "Errors by page" show where the errors happen.
RebelErrorTracking.DocSame: Two errors are the same when they have the same type, message and file. Numbers and long IDs are left out of the comparison, so "Order 12 failed" and "Order 13 failed" are one error, and so is an error in a script whose file name changes with each release.
RebelErrorTracking.DocSameTitle: What counts as the same error
RebelErrorTracking.DocSegments: The segments "Error type", "Error message" and "Error file" narrow any report of Matomo to the visits that match. Use them to compare the visits that had an error with the ones that did not, for the conversion rate for example. A segment works on visits: on the Errors page it shows all errors of the visits that match. The visit log and the visitor profile list the errors of a visit among its page views. Some segments to start from:
RebelErrorTracking.DocSettings: Each website has three settings, under Administration > Websites > Manage: whether errors are tracked, whether browser warnings are tracked, and a list of texts for errors to ignore. An error is not stored when its message or file contains one of the texts. Errors are kept for %s days; a super user changes that under Administration > System > General settings.
RebelErrorTracking.DocStart: Nothing has to change in the tracking code of a website. The plugin adds itself to the JavaScript tracker of Matomo, also when the tracker is loaded through Matomo Tag Manager. If Matomo is not allowed to write the tracker file, an administrator of the server runs this once after the plugin is activated or updated:
RebelErrorTracking.DocStored: An error is sent once for each page load, and at most %1$s errors for each page load. A visit stores at most %2$s. Errors from browser extensions are not sent. Addresses are stored without what follows ? and #. Errors go through the tracker of Matomo, so consent, opt-out and the exclusions of the website apply, and they are deleted together with the visit they belong to. An error is not a page view and does not change the other reports.
RebelErrorTracking.ErrorRetentionRange: Enter a number of days between %1$s and %2$s.
RebelErrorTracking.ErrorsByBrowserDocumentation: The browsers and versions the errors happened in. An error that only one browser has points at something that browser does not support.
RebelErrorTracking.ErrorsByPageDocumentation: The pages the errors happened on, without what follows ? and # in their address.
RebelErrorTracking.ErrorsOverTimeDocumentation: How many errors happened in the browsers of your visitors, and in how many visits.
RebelErrorTracking.ErrorsReportDocumentation: The errors that happened in the browsers of your visitors: JavaScript errors, promises that were rejected without being handled, and images, scripts and stylesheets that failed to load. The same error is one row. Click a row to see when it last happened, on which page and with which stack trace.
RebelErrorTracking.PluginDescription: Track JavaScript errors and other errors the browser can capture on the sites you measure.
RebelErrorTracking.SettingBrowserWarningsHelp: Also store what the browser reports about the website: features it uses that are deprecated, and things the browser stopped it from doing. Chromium-based browsers send these for every page view that is affected, so they can be many.
RebelErrorTracking.SettingEnabledHelp: Store the errors that happen in the browsers of the visitors of this website.
RebelErrorTracking.SettingIgnoredHelp: One text on each line. An error is not stored when its message or its file contains one of them. Upper and lower case are treated the same.
RebelErrorTracking.SettingRetentionHelp: Errors older than this are deleted.
